attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as the DNS resolver for a new private network (10.50.50.0/24) shared with node2/node3, using an Ansible playbook run from node4 (the only node with Ansible installed, so it served as control node). node1 answers inventory.internal authoritatively with node2's private address (10.50.50.2) and forwards all other queries upstream (10.100.231.1, 1.1.1.1). node2 and node3 were configured to use node1 (10.50.50.1) as their sole nameserver. All four nodes were then restarted one at a time per the mandatory restart-evidence protocol, with boot-id changes and full service/config/data recovery verified on each.
